entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: Cross-process-chain upper/lower injection serial recordings: injection_pressure_actual.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Direct actual injection-pressure channel; raw serial headers do not explicitly encode physical units.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: Actual pressure can be compared within a documented workpiece/process lane, but raw magnitudes are not cross-machine pressure limits while units remain absent.

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: Cross-process-chain injection_pressure_target command channel paired with actual pressure.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Command/target signal; physical unit is not explicit in raw serial headers and it is not counted as a direct measured physical sample.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: A target is controller intent, not proof of delivered melt pressure; command and actual must remain separate in diagnostics.

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: Difference or other explicitly defined tracking feature between cross-process injection_pressure_target and injection_pressure_actual.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Derived source-scaled error feature; inherits unresolved pressure units and requires synchronized command/actual samples.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: Tracking error can reveal response changes but cannot alone distinguish valve, hydraulic, material, control or sensing causes.

evidence.role: paired target and actual pressure channels

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: Cross-process-chain injection_velocity channel in injection-moulding serial recordings.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Direct named injection-velocity channel; raw source headers do not encode a physical unit.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: Use velocity as a within-source actual process signal; do not infer mm/s or transfer values unless the source explicitly establishes them.

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: Cross-process-chain melt_volume channel captured with injection-moulding serial data.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Direct named melt-volume channel with source scale preserved because raw serial units are not explicit.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: Melt-volume trends can support shot/fill consistency analysis but cannot be converted to universal shot volume or part mass without machine/material context.

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: Cross-process-chain upper injection traces include a state channel marking source machine/process state.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Categorical/numeric machine state as published; it is a controller/state signal, not a physical sensor measurement.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: State is useful for phase segmentation only with the source mapping; state numbers must not be interpreted as physical measurements or reused across machines.

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: Cross-process-chain recordings retain per-file acquisition metadata; lower files expose a sampling-rate field.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Per-file timing metadata overrides any temptation to force one global approximately-1-kHz rate onto all traces.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: Time derivatives and cross-lane comparisons require each file's own observed time basis; dataset-level approximate sampling is not a substitute.

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: Upper and lower cross-process injection lanes have related but non-identical serial schemas and sampling structures.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Schema identity includes lane, channel set, time basis and file-level metadata; missing fields are not silently imputed.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: A model or diagnostic feature defined on the upper lane requires explicit revalidation before it is applied to lower-lane recordings.

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: Cross-process archive contains non-contiguous cycle IDs and seven lower static references whose serial files are absent.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Cycle identifiers are identifiers, not counts; exact existing files define accepted records and missing references remain explicit.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: Cycle-number maxima must not be treated as cycle counts, and missing referenced files must not be fabricated or silently interpolated.

evidence.role: enumerated cycle IDs and missing-file audit
